text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating opener that connects a new contrastive case to the preceding communal sequence without merging the scenes

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: topicalizing particle that partitions the new case

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens by joining this ayah to the prior communal sequence, but the following {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) keeps the Thamūd case partitioned. The reader hears continuity without scene-collapse: this is another case in the proof, not a loose continuation of the previous episode.

topics.headline: coordinated but partitioned case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is connected to the previous communal sequence while still opening a distinct Thamūd case.
topics.reason: The opening coordinator precedes the topicalizing frame, so continuity and partition operate together.

words.gloss_range: topicalizing case-particle that front-loads Thamūd and requires a following response clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: proper-name case heading

words.prose: {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) makes Thamūd a marked case-heading and waits for its answer. That answer comes through the following response link, so guidance becomes the first legally relevant fact in the compressed history. The doubled sound also gives the boundary audible weight before the case unfolds.

topics.headline: topic frame requiring response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Thamūd held as a marked case until the response clause assigns guidance as the first fact.
topics.reason: The particle is a topicalizing case frame that requires a following response.

topics.headline: case frame compresses history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a whole communal history compressed into linked predicates under one heading.
topics.reason: The following clauses unfold guidance, preference, seizure, and cause as entries under the topic.

topics.headline: sound-weighted topic boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant as a small pause that reinforces the grammatical partition.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports the same boundary function without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: identified historical community as a nominative case-heading; collective moral accountability is filed under the proper name
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name range tied to a historical people; any scant-water etymological pressure remains secondary to the referential civilizational name
words.prose: {{ar:ثَمُودُ}} ({{tr:thamūdu}}) is a proper name, so the ayah is not speaking about generic rejecters. The named community becomes the heading under which guidance, preference, seizure, and earned cause are filed, and its placement between the topic particle and the response link lets the listener hear the name held as a framed case before the action begins. Variant case behavior is useful as apparatus, but it does not displace the local topic role; the fuller Thamūd-and-sign narrative (7:73) and the earlier shock warning (41:13) remain compressed behind this case-heading.

topics.headline: named community as case heading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a named civilization, not a generic moral type, carries the entire accountability sequence.
topics.reason: The proper noun is nominative after the topicalizing particle and later plural forms route back to it.

topics.headline: case variants expose name behavior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case behavior tests the proper name formally while leaving its local case-heading role intact.
topics.reason: The variants are useful as contrastive apparatus, but the local aligned surface remains the topical name.

topics.headline: proper name with secondary root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps any scant-water name pressure as background while reading the word primarily as a historical people.
topics.reason: No local grammar turns the proper name into a lexical description, so derivational pressure remains secondary.

topics.headline: Thamūd as recurring precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this named case as part of a larger precedent network, including the fuller messenger-sign scene (7:73) and the earlier warning in this surah (41:13).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence points that clarify how 41:17 compresses a broader known case.

topics.headline: cadence frames the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the proper name held between the topic particle and response link before the action begins.
topics.reason: The cadence row reinforces the case-heading function already established by grammar.

words.gloss_range: response fa that answers the topic frame and launches the guidance clause as the first predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: topic frame that this connector answers

words.prose: The first {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) answers the {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) frame and attaches the case-heading directly to the guidance verb. It also begins the ayah's ordered chain: guidance is the first link before preference and seizure can be read as accountability.

topics.headline: response link to guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is grammatically compelled as the response to the topic frame, not merely appended.
topics.reason: The particle answers the topicalizing frame and is prefixed directly to the guidance verb.

topics.headline: first link in accountability chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah ordered from guidance to preference to seizure, with this link starting the sequence.
topics.reason: The three connector rows support an ordered accountability chain, and this is its first verbal link.

words.gloss_range: completed direct guidance delivered to Thamūd; the recipients are grammatically bound to the later object pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, showing a way, right direction, course, and bestowed or sent guidance; locally selected as completed direct guidance to recipients

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the rejected guidance noun later in the ayah

words.prose: {{ar:هَدَيْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:hadaynāhum}}) presents guidance as a completed act delivered to the named people. The attached object suffix makes Thamūd direct recipients, and that same recipient identity later returns as the seized object. The guidance field carries disclosed direction and path-access; echoes such as the two-way disclosure (90:10) and the later same-surah guidance/blindness contrast (41:44) sharpen the point that blindness is not caused by lack of guidance.

topics.headline: completed guidance to recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance was completed and directly received before the later preference appears.
topics.reason: The perfect verb with an object suffix presents Thamūd as direct recipients of guidance.

topics.headline: guidance as disclosed direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears guidance as disclosed direction and path-access, while the local verb keeps it a completed act of guiding rather than every root branch.
topics.reason: The h-d-y range supports guiding and direction; gift and route pressures enrich the local act without replacing the grammar.

topics.headline: guidance thread across contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the completed guidance here with the two-way disclosure (90:10), the later guidance/blindness contrast (41:44), and the rejected guidance noun in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete echo points that sharpen the local claim that blindness follows disclosed direction.

words.gloss_range: sequential fa that turns supplied guidance into the immediate preference-response and reversal hinge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preference response that follows guidance

words.prose: This {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns from supplied guidance to the people's response. It is a hinge rather than a mere spacer: the ayah moves immediately from direction given to blindness preferred, so the reversal is grammatically audible.

topics.headline: guidance-to-preference hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an immediate grammatical turn from guidance supplied to blindness preferred.
topics.reason: The connector links the guidance clause to the preference response and carries sequential reversal force.

words.gloss_range: completed collective preference, with blindness as object and guidance as the ranked-against comparator
words.root_gloss_range: love, attachment, making beloved, and preferring; local Form X selects comparative preference rather than simple affection

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: chosen blindness object
ranked-against guidance comparator

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟}} ({{tr:istaḥabbū}}) makes the rejection an act of valuation. Its construction takes {{ar:ٱلْعَمَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ʿamā}}) as the chosen object and ranks it over {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}), so the love-root pressure becomes comparative preference rather than simple affection. As the completed plural middle verb, it is the point where Thamūd acts as collective evaluators before the next clause makes them seized patients. The same preference formula appears in rejection contexts such as preferring worldly life (14:3), while here it is narrowed into blindness over guidance.

topics.headline: object plus comparator ranking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb turns blindness and guidance into a ranked moral inversion.
topics.reason: Local grammar gives an object and an over-against comparator, so the Form X preference claim is fully licensed.

topics.headline: completed collective valuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Thamūd acting collectively at the center of the ayah before they become seized patients.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb resumes the topic and functions as the middle pivot between provision and seizure.

topics.headline: rejection formula narrowed locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a broader preference formula, including preferring worldly life (14:3), narrowed here to blindness over guidance.
topics.reason: The echo supports a rejection-pattern comparison, while the local object and comparator determine the exact content.

words.gloss_range: definite moral-perceptual blindness treated as the selected object in the preference clause
words.root_gloss_range: loss of sight, inner blindness, obscurity, delusion, and pathless confusion; locally selected as moral-perceptual blindness chosen over guidance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opposed guidance benchmark

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَمَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ʿamā}}) is not a vague bad condition; it is the definite object they chose. The blindness field moves from physical sight-loss into moral and cognitive occlusion, and the grammar makes that occlusion selectable. The contrast with later blindness (17:72) and the same-surah guidance/blindness echo (41:44) keeps the central inversion sharp.

topics.headline: definite blindness as chosen object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees blindness objectified as the thing selected, not merely as an accidental condition.
topics.reason: The definite gerund is the direct object of the preference verb and balances the comparator phrase.

topics.headline: blindness as moral occlusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the sight-loss image as cognitive and moral occlusion chosen against available direction.
topics.reason: The root range includes physical and inner blindness, and the local preference context selects the moral-perceptual extension.

topics.headline: central antithesis and echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the chosen blindness here with the guidance antithesis in the same surah (41:44) and the eschatological blindness contrast (17:72).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete echo points while local grammar keeps the word as the chosen object.

words.gloss_range: comparison preposition in a preference construction; it ranks blindness over guidance rather than marking ordinary physical height

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed comparator in the preference construction

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) governs {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) as the comparator in a preference construction. Its ordinary over-against spatial feel survives as irony: blindness is ranked above guidance, but the grammar keeps the role comparative rather than physical elevation.

topics.headline: comparison marker for rejected alternative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is positioned as the ranked-against alternative, not a separate object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the guidance noun as comparator after the preference verb.

topics.headline: over-against irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony of blindness placed over guidance while local grammar keeps the sense comparative.
topics.reason: The spatial value supplies image-pressure, but the construction blocks a literal elevation reading.

words.gloss_range: definite guidance as the known rejected alternative and benchmark in the comparison phrase
words.root_gloss_range: guidance, right direction, route, course, and bestowed direction; locally selected as the known benchmark rejected in comparison

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: comparison preposition governing the rejected guidance benchmark
earlier completed guiding act from the same root

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) closes the preference clause as the rejected benchmark. It is governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), not made the direct object, so guidance is displaced rather than absent. The noun reprises the earlier verb {{ar:هَدَيْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:hadaynāhum}}), and echoes such as guidance for the receptive (2:2) and the same-surah return of guidance against blindness (41:44) make the rejection more pointed.

topics.headline: guidance as rejected comparator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is displaced as the alternative they ranked beneath blindness.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the comparison preposition rather than serving as direct object.

topics.headline: known guidance made objectifiable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees guidance as known and available, now packaged as the benchmark refused.
topics.reason: The definite gerund carries the guidance field and reprises the earlier completed guiding act.

topics.headline: guidance formula and same-root return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this rejected guidance with the receptive-guidance formula (2:2), the same-surah contrast (41:44), and the earlier verb in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The echo rows preserve concrete formulaic and same-root pressures without changing the local comparator role.

words.gloss_range: resultative fa that links the preference directly to punitive seizure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: seizure verb introduced as result

words.prose: The third {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the move from preference to seizure resultative. Punishment is not left floating as an unrelated event; the connector pivots from human choice into punitive agency.

topics.headline: preference-to-seizure result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seizure follows as consequence from the chosen preference, not as an isolated punishment scene.
topics.reason: The connector links the preference clause to the punitive seizure clause as result and sequence.

words.gloss_range: punitive seizure of the same group previously guided; the delayed shock-subject turns them from choosing agents into patients
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, receiving, and capturing; locally the missing V4 root evidence is supplemented by grammar, which selects punitive seizure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: delayed subject of the seizure verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذَتْهُمْ}} ({{tr:akhadhathum}}) reverses the earlier recipienthood: the same attached plural object that marked them as guided recipients now marks them as seized patients. The feminine verb anticipates the delayed subject {{ar:صَٰعِقَةُ}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatu}}), so the shock is the actor and Thamūd becomes patient. The thunderbolt-seizure parallel (2:55) sharpens the irony of sight, shock, and refusal.

topics.headline: guided recipients become seized patients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same group from recipients of guidance to objects of seizure.
topics.reason: The attached object suffix resumes the same plural community previously guided.

topics.headline: shock subject seizes them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees an inanimate shock made grammatical actor while the community loses agency.
topics.reason: The feminine verb agrees with the delayed feminine subject and takes the group as object.

topics.headline: thunderbolt-seizure parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this seizure within a thunderbolt-seizure formula, including the parallel in 2:55.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels sharpen the local punitive-capture sense without changing its grammar.

words.gloss_range: shock/thunderbolt-like punishment as delayed grammatical subject and construct head for the punishment phrase
words.root_gloss_range: shock, thunderbolt-like blast, stunning, and being struck senseless or dead; locally a shock-event becomes the subject that seizes

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive punishment complement

words.prose: {{ar:صَٰعِقَةُ}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatu}}) arrives after the verb-object sequence as the delayed subject that did the seizing. Its construct relation to {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) prevents a disaster-only reading: the shock is a sudden, overpowering punishment-bearing force. The earlier same-surah warning of a shock like that of ʿĀd and Thamūd (41:13) returns here as realized outcome.

topics.headline: delayed shock-subject carries agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shock itself is made the seizing subject after the object has already appeared.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative delayed subject and construct head for the punishment phrase.

topics.headline: thunderbolt-like shock form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the punishment as sudden, overwhelming shock rather than a generic harm.
topics.reason: The root branches support shock, thunderbolt, and stunning; the local noun selects the punishment-bearing shock sense.

topics.headline: warning shock returns as outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the realized shock here with the earlier warning about a shock like that of ʿĀd and Thamūd (41:13).
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence turns the warning field into the subject of the outcome clause.

words.gloss_range: definite punishment classifying the shock as moral recompense, then qualified by humiliation
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, torment, severe pain, and answerability, alongside remote unrelated branches such as sweetness or withholding that are not local

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: humiliating qualifier of punishment

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) classifies the shock as punishment, not mere catastrophe. The genitive construct makes the shock belong to a punitive class of painful answerability, and the following qualifier adds humiliation to pain. Wider punishment recurrence, including warning-punishment language (54:16), supports that moral category without importing unrelated root branches.

topics.headline: shock classified as punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shock is classified as punishment and then qualified, not left as raw disaster.
topics.reason: The genitive construct links the shock head to punishment and the following qualifier modifies that punishment.

topics.headline: punishment branch selected locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears painful answerability as the selected branch, while remote sweetness or withholding branches are not active here.
topics.reason: The local construct with shock and humiliation selects the punishment branch from a wider root range.

topics.headline: punishment joined to humiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the consequence as both pain and status-collapse, because punishment is immediately paired with humiliation.
topics.reason: The adjacent qualifier creates a two-dimensional consequence: punitive pain and abasement.

words.gloss_range: definite humiliating abasement attached to the punishment, adding status-loss to pain
words.root_gloss_range: gentleness, ease, lightness, and humiliation; locally the punishment phrase selects abasement and status-loss

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: punishment noun qualified by humiliation
earlier over-against comparator answered by abasement

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُونِ}} ({{tr:al-hūni}}) makes the punishment humiliating, not only painful. The local phrase selects abasement, contempt, and status-loss from the root range and attaches that pressure as a definite qualifier to {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}), while ease or gentleness remain outside this punishment phrase. It answers the false elevation of blindness over guidance with lowering, and the previous disgrace field (41:16) carries into Thamūd's case.

topics.headline: humiliation locked to punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humiliation as an intrinsic qualifier of the punishment, not incidental aftermath.
topics.reason: The definite genitive qualifier modifies the punishment noun inside the phrase.

topics.headline: abasement selected from wider range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears status-loss and contempt as the selected pressure, while ease or gentleness remain outside the local punishment phrase.
topics.reason: The local modification of punishment selects the humiliation branch; the variant is preserved as contrast, not replacement.

topics.headline: false elevation answered by abasement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier ranking of blindness over guidance answered by a lowering punishment and same-surah disgrace field (41:16).
topics.reason: The rows link the over-against preference image to the humiliation term and to the previous disgrace field.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition attaching the seizure to the broad earned cause that follows

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: broad object governed by the causal preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the seizure to its cause. Joined to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), the preposition binds the whole following earning clause to the punishment, so the ayah does not end with spectacle; it turns the final beat toward grounds and accountability.

topics.headline: seizure attached to earned cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase gives the grounds of the seizure, not a loose aftermath.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the broad object and attaches the relative clause to the seizure as causal complement.

topics.headline: compact connector turns event to grounds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from the punishment event to accountability in a compact final connector.
topics.reason: The fused preposition-plus-object form closes the ayah by binding cause without a heavy explanatory opener.

words.gloss_range: broad relative or maṣdar-like object of the causal preposition, opening the full earning clause as grounds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal preposition governing the broad object
habitual earning clause filling the causal object

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens a broad causal object for {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}). Whether heard as what they earned or as their earning, it leaves the cause wide enough to gather the habitual clause rather than naming one isolated deed. The final explanation is compressed, not vague.

topics.headline: broad object of causal preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole earning clause functioning as the causal object, not a detached explanation.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the causal preposition and filled by the following auxiliary-imperfect clause.

topics.headline: open scope gathers the ledger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cause remains broad enough to include the field or process of habitual earning rather than one named deed.
topics.reason: Relative and maṣdar-like readings both preserve broad causal scope under the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: deficient past auxiliary that makes the earning clause habitual and durative rather than punctual
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurring, temporal predication, state, and auxiliary framing; locally the deficient verb supplies past habitual aspect

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect predicate framed by the auxiliary

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) is semantically light but structurally decisive. With {{ar:يَكْسِبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaksibūn}}), it frames the cause as past habitual conduct, not one punctual act, and its plural form carries the Thamūd collective into the final causal close. The being-root's broad range is narrowed here to auxiliary duration; contrast with the divine bringing-to-be formula (36:82) helps show that this local use is moral persistence, not creation-command force.

topics.headline: auxiliary gives past habitual duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earning is framed as a settled temporal pattern rather than a single act.
topics.reason: The deficient verb functions as auxiliary with the imperfect predicate and supplies durative past aspect.

topics.headline: plural subject in causal close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the collective subject into the final cause clause.
topics.reason: The plural ending resumes the opening communal topic inside the causal closure.

topics.headline: habit marker and root contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes this local auxiliary of human habit from divine bringing-to-be (36:82), while same-surah recurrence marks communal states.
topics.reason: The root range includes being and occurrence, but local syntax selects auxiliary duration; recurrence and contrast sharpen that limit.

words.gloss_range: imperfect earning/acquiring as accrued liability, closing the ayah on responsibility rather than spectacle
words.root_gloss_range: earning, gaining, acquiring, and incurring liability; locally conduct is accrued as the causal ground of punishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: broad causal object-field
auxiliary that makes the earning habitual

words.prose: {{ar:يَكْسِبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaksibūn}}) makes the final cause an ongoing acquisition that returns as liability. The broad {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the object-field, while the imperfect under {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) keeps accrual open across time. The ayah ends on earning rather than on thunderbolt, so responsibility is the last pressure; the earning principle also scales from individual accountability (2:286) to this communal case.

topics.headline: ongoing earning under auxiliary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the cause as ongoing accrual under the auxiliary, not completed one-time earning.
topics.reason: The imperfect predicate under the deficient verb presents repeated past process.

topics.headline: broad object gathers deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the unnamed object-field gathered by the broad causal pronoun rather than restricted to one deed.
topics.reason: The verb can take an object, and local grammar supplies the broad object through the preceding pronoun.

topics.headline: acquisition returns as liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears gain-language turned into incurred liability: what they acquired becomes the cause that seizes them.
topics.reason: The punishment context and causal phrase select liability-producing acquisition from the broader earning range.

topics.headline: final word closes on responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with communal earning rather than the thunderbolt, making responsibility the last semantic pressure.
topics.reason: The plural imperfect is the final word and keeps the named community active in the stated cause.

topics.headline: earning principle and same-surah echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects communal earning here with the individual earning principle (2:286) and the later same-surah shift from earning to doing (41:27).
topics.reason: The echoes are retained as accountability parallels, while local syntax keeps this word as the final imperfect earning verb.

baseline_models.mechanism: Gentle disclosure supplies a route and truth, but preference ranks loss of insight above that supplied guidance; the failure is evaluative rather than informational.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies both the offered orientation and the rejected comparator.
Heart-attached love and preference make blindness the positively preferred object, not a mere deficit.
Blindness of insight and confusion about the true route names the orientation they rank above guidance.

changed_reading.before: Thamud failed to find guidance and consequently remained blind.
changed_reading.after: Guidance reached Thamud, but they reordered value so that impaired insight became preferable to the known route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated acquisition produces a liability that returns as an upper catastrophic event, takes hold of its producers, and holds them answerable.

activation_trace.role: Taking as accountability for an offense turns the event's seizure into answerability.
The severe upper crash supplies the concrete event that arrives and overwhelms.
Painful punishment identifies the crash as a penal consequence rather than neutral weather.
Occurrence across time gives the earning clause its sustained, established aspect.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the production metaphor whose yield becomes liability.

changed_reading.before: A thunderbolt struck, with their deeds given as a general reason.
changed_reading.after: Their sustained acquisitions mature into the very liability that arrives as punitive seizure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The punishment does not only hurt; it lowers, exposes as slight, and reverses the standing of those who treated guidance as beneath preference.

activation_trace.role: Penal pain supplies the bodily and judicial base of the consequence.
Contemptuous abasement makes loss of standing an intrinsic quality of the punishment.
The split mapping's image of contempt and weakness sharpens the punishment's status-lowering force.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes a painful punishment.
changed_reading.after: It describes pain that publicly converts asserted standing into contempt and weakness.

baseline_models.mechanism: A route tableau joins the advancing guide, a markerless terrain in which one cannot orient, and eventual capture by the catastrophic event.

activation_trace.role: The guide or foremost element supplies an available leader at the head of movement.
Unknown land without orienting marks spatializes blindness as chosen entry into an unnavigable field.
Capture and arrest close the failed journey by removing further movement.
The overwhelming upper crash is the event that catches the disoriented travelers.

changed_reading.before: The verse alternates abstract guidance and blindness, then reports punishment.
changed_reading.after: It can also be read as a failed journey: the available leader is rejected, markerless terrain is selected, and arrest ends the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier audience turns its side, declines operative hearing, and describes nested barriers in heart, ear, and interpersonal space; this makes the focus blindness a maintained reception architecture.

activation_trace.role: Supplied indication anchors the model in guidance that actually reaches the addressee.
Loss of inward sight is the focus condition that the surrounding barriers help produce.
Turning one's side supplies the initiating bodily act of withdrawal from the message.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that the failed channel is practical reception, not sound alone.
A protective covering supplies the claimed inner enclosure around the heart.
Weight in the ear supplies a second barrier that loads the auditory channel.
Prevention of access supplies the social barrier placed between speaker and audience.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 moves from turning away and not hearing to a three-layer first-person account of covered hearts, weighted ears, and a barrier between parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal plus nested barriers; I infer a maintained perceptual enclosure that culminates in 41:17's preferred blindness. A live alternative is that 41:5 reports excuses rather than actual mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: Preferred blindness is an inward choice stated without a process.
changed_reading.after: Preferred blindness is the endpoint of repeatedly turning, disabling practical hearing, and maintaining inner, sensory, and social partitions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky and earth answer command through willing compliance set against aversion, so the focus verb of preference stands out as an ordering of volition rather than incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Preference rooted in attached love supplies the focus act whose volitional quality is tested by the cosmic contrast.
Compliance and obedience supply the willing pole of response to disclosed command.
Aversion opposed to satisfaction supplies the alternative affective pole under which compliance still occurs.

structural_cues: 41:11 explicitly stages طوعا أو كرها before both created realms answer أتينا طائعين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a willing-versus-averse response frame; I infer that it sensitizes 41:17's استحبوا as culpable value alignment. A live alternative is that the creation scene and Thamud scene are parallel only at a broad rhetorical level.

changed_reading.before: Thamud's preference is one isolated act of choosing.
changed_reading.after: Against a surah-wide grammar of response under command, their preference marks a specifically misaligned will: they ease themselves toward blindness after orientation is supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same thunderbolt is announced before the paired Aad-Thamud account, where self-exaltation and knowing denial meet disgrace; the focus punishment of abasement therefore executes a warned reversal of rank.

activation_trace.role: Abasement through contempt supplies the focus event's status-lowering result.
The severe upper crash is explicitly preannounced and compared with the crashes of Aad and Thamud.
Self-magnification supplies the elevated status claim that the following punishment reverses.
Denial despite knowledge joins asserted superiority to culpable rejection of available signs.
Disgrace as humiliation, exposure, and exclusion supplies the adjacent analogue for punishment characterized by abasement.

structural_cues: 41:13 announces one comparable thunderbolt, and the فَأَمَّا عَادٌ / وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ pairing runs through 41:15-17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, paired peoples, self-exaltation, disgrace, and the focus abasement; I infer a status-reversal arrow from claimed height to imposed lowliness. A live alternative is that Aad's disgrace and Thamud's abasement remain distinct punishment descriptions.

changed_reading.before: The thunderbolt is a sudden lethal disaster that happens to be humiliating.
changed_reading.after: The announced thunderbolt judicially reverses rank: rejection that elevates the self ends in an event whose punishment is precisely abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chosen non-seeing cannot suppress evidence: hearing, sight, and skin become knowledgeable witnesses, failed concealment is traced to conjecture, and that conjecture itself causes the fall.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of insight supplies the focus strategy that later bodily testimony defeats.
Knowledgeable declaration turns the body from a blocked receiver into an evidentiary speaker.
Actual ocular sight supplies evidence from the very faculty opposed by the focus blindness.
The body's outer covering becomes a witness, reversing covering from concealment into disclosure.
Covering and concealment supply the failed attempt to keep embodied evidence from appearing.
Conjecture and imagined belief identify the epistemic substitute installed in place of guidance.
Falling into destruction supplies the causal endpoint attributed to the false conjecture.

structural_cues: 41:20-23 moves from organs testifying about deeds to the failed assumption that God did not know, then makes that assumption the subject that destroyed them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony, attempted concealment, conjecture, and resulting ruin; I infer that preferred blindness is strategic interpretation rather than literal sensory absence. A live alternative is that the testimony scene concerns later accountability without explaining the earlier blindness.

changed_reading.before: Blindness means that evidence could not be perceived.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is a chosen rule for suppressing evidence; perception remains stored in the body and later overrules the chosen account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attached companions beautify the whole temporal field, then a group deliberately mixes noise into hearing to prevail; preference for blindness is socially curated through attraction and channel interference.

activation_trace.role: Attached preference supplies the valuation that companions and noise-making can shape.
Obfuscation and induced confusion supply the focus result of the social interference.
A companion bound to another supplies the durable social carrier of the reframing.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the positive attraction that converts obstruction into preference.
Hearing as understanding and compliance is the channel the coordinated command targets.
Mixed vocal clamor supplies the active acoustic interference used to block reception.
Overpowering force supplies the declared social objective of the anti-hearing campaign.

structural_cues: 41:25's companions beautify what lies before and behind, immediately followed by 41:26's plural command not to listen and to make noise in order to prevail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached companions, beautification, organized noise, and a victory aim; I infer a social-production arrow into the focus preference without removing personal agency. A live alternative is that 41:25 and 41:26 describe separate causes rather than one coordinated mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Preference remains culpable but is socially manufactured: companions beautify the blind field while collective noise prevents guidance from becoming operative hearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus earning clause is expanded by repeated formulas of matching recompense and by the rule that righteous action accrues for the self while evil falls upon it.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the focus ledger metaphor.
Accountability for an offense makes seizure the collection side of that ledger.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the conversion rule from conduct to outcome.
Purposive action identifies what is repeatedly produced and then recompensed.
Denial despite knowledge specifies the culpable content entered into the repeated recompense formula.
The self as the thing itself fixes the destination to which the action's result returns.
The act that causes harm supplies the adverse entry explicitly said to fall against its doer.

structural_cues: 41:27-28 repeats recompense for what they used to do or deny, while 41:46 states the directional rule فلنفسه / فعليها.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning, matching recompense, repeated conduct, and self-directed consequence; I infer a produced-output relation rather than arbitrary retaliation. A live alternative is ordinary legal causation without a strict ledger or equivalence.

changed_reading.before: Their earnings merely establish blame for an externally assigned penalty.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated conduct produces an adverse account whose yield returns to the producing self and is collected as seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rejected orientation ends in an upper crash that seizes, while maintained straightness receives descending allies and prepared hospitality in which desire is fulfilled; the surah pairs two ways an outcome arrives.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intended course supply the focus orientation whose rejection defines one arrival regime.
The upper crash supplies the destructive arrival that takes hold after rejected orientation.
Straightness and balanced uprightness supply the maintained route opposed to preferred blindness.
Descent and arrival supply the benign counterpart to the focus's upper catastrophic event.
The soul's movement toward what it desires supplies a rightly placed counterpart to Thamud's destructive preference.
The inner faculty of mind and impulse locates fulfilled desire in the same evaluative interior where preference operates.
Prepared hospitality for the arriving guest makes the benign outcome an ordered reception rather than mere escape.

structural_cues: 41:30-32 links استقاموا, angelic descent, fulfilled desire, and نُزُلًا; 41:17 links rejected هدى, an upper crash, and seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two orientations and two descending or arriving outcomes; I infer a paired reception architecture. A live alternative is that angelic descent and the thunderbolt are not intended as formal counterparts.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives only the negative consequence of a bad preference.
changed_reading.after: The focus occupies one side of a two-arrival system: rejected direction draws seizing catastrophe, while straight direction receives allies, hospitality, and rightly fulfilled desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Quran is explicitly guidance and healing for one reception posture but ear-weight and blindness for another, rendered as a call across distance; blindness is therefore a receiver relation to disclosure, not opacity in the disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The supplied road and truth anchor the focus claim that disclosure was available before preference.
Blindness of insight anchors the adverse reception state that 41:44 explicitly repeats.
Guidance as indication toward truth names the beneficial effect of the message for believers.
Healing and restoration show that successful reception repairs rather than merely informs.
Weight in the ear supplies the receiver-side load that blocks operative hearing.
Repeated blindness of insight makes the focus contrast an explicit surah-wide reception bifurcation.
Distance from nearness spatializes failed reception as a call whose source has been made remote.

structural_cues: 41:44 assigns opposed effects to the same message and closes with the image of people called from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one message, two receiver classes, opposite effects, and distance; I infer that 41:17's preference changes the message's operative effect without changing its clarity. A live alternative is that 41:44 describes stable kinds of hearer rather than a reception process.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and blindness are two objects independently available for selection.
changed_reading.after: The disclosed message itself becomes healing guidance or experienced blindness according to reception; preferring blindness means producing distance from an unchanged call.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refusal repeatedly takes spatial form: inclination from the straight line, withdrawal by one's side, distant schism, and lost direction; meanwhile signs expand across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intended course supply the axis from which the contextual motions depart.
Markerless terrain supplies the focus image of losing navigability after leaving the axis.
Inclination away from straightness and truth supplies the first explicit off-axis movement.
Drawing the side away makes refusal an embodied increase of distance.
Withdrawal and separation by the side complete the bodily posture of self-displacement.
Straying from guidance and intended direction names the resulting route condition.
Inclination from the intended course toward a separate side makes schism a directional split.
Distance from nearness measures how far the selected side has carried the hearer.
Far horizons widen the external field in which orienting signs are made available.
Emergence into clarity supplies the endpoint of the expanding disclosure.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality identifies what becomes clear despite the cultivated distance.

structural_cues: 41:40, 41:51, and 41:52 repeat lateral deviation and distance, while 41:53 answers with signs across the widest external and internal fields until clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of sideward motions and an expanding field of signs; I infer one spatial mechanism in which blindness is self-positioning off the guidance axis. A live alternative is that these are independent metaphors without a continuous topology.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is a stationary lack of vision.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is active self-relocation: one inclines, turns a side, opens a distant split, and thereby inhabits terrain made unnavigable despite widening signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The branch image of ع م ي as choosing and aiming is surprising because the surface noun ordinarily activates blindness, not the branch's verbal scope. It remains packet-anchored to the focus root and is independently reinforced by استحبوا; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary branch echo that doubles intentionality, not as the noun's primary morphology.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the explicit act of selecting one object over another.
The branch image of choosing and aiming makes the selected object itself carry an exploratory echo of intention.

changed_reading.before: Preference is intentional, while blindness is only its passive object.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, the phrase can momentarily double-mark intention: they prefer a blindness whose root inventory also contains directed choosing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's form-distant ه د ي to ه د د mapping, so it is surprising and must not be stated as an etymology. It remains anchored because the focus directly joins ه د ي to صاعقة and 41:13 preannounces that crash; downstream prose should label it a split-root acoustic and warning resonance.

activation_trace.role: The split root's threat and warning image casts rejected guidance as also containing an admonitory edge.
The split root's severe sound and reverberation image supplies an acoustic bridge to the thunderbolt.
Severe piercing sound realizes the acoustic pole inside the focus punishment.
The earlier announced upper crash keeps warning, sound, and eventual event in one traceable sequence.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is gentle disclosure and the thunderbolt is a wholly separate later sanction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, rejected guidance carries warning and severe sound in shadow before that sound arrives materially as the announced crash.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading عذاب through its branch of withholding and weaning is branch-distant from the surface's primary punishment sense, and the contrast with 41:8 is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in العذاب and يكسبون and gains a whole-surah counterpoint from reward that is not cut off; downstream prose should retain it only as an exploratory deprivation layer beneath penal pain.

activation_trace.role: Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply an exploratory interruption of attachment to what was pursued.
Pursued acquisition supplies the gain stream from which punishment can be read as forced severance.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supplies the negated counter-image in reward described as uncut.

changed_reading.before: Punishment adds pain after a sequence of acquisitions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, punishment also weans the earners from their chosen gain stream, opposite the uncut reward attached to another mode of action.

strongest_changes: The focus blindness became a maintained reception architecture built from turning away, weighted hearing, coverings, and barriers.
Bodily testimony changed blindness from missing evidence into a chosen suppression rule that cannot erase stored evidence.
Companions, beautification, and organized noise exposed preference as socially engineered without canceling personal responsibility.
The explicit 41:44 recurrence showed one message becoming guidance and healing or blindness and distance according to reception.
Repeated recompense and self-directed action turned يكسبون into a produced-output model of punitive seizure.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly spatialized and operationalized the focus contrast: reception is enclosed or opened, routes bend or straighten, outcomes arrive, and the same disclosure has opposite effects without itself becoming unclear.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Aad's self-exaltation and disgrace to Thamud's punishment of abasement depends on reading the paired account as one status-reversal mechanism.
The pairing of thunderbolt with angelic descent and hospitality is structurally suggestive but not explicitly marked as a binary.
The three outliers depend on branch-distant or split-root activations and should remain qualified rather than enter an unmarked synthesis.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Misguidance as an affective exchange, not missing information.** **ه د ي B001/B002** supplies gentle guidance and intended course, **ح ب ب B002** clinging attachment, and **ع م ي B002** blindness of insight. The construction explicitly places blindness over guidance as the preferred object. I infer that desire binds the chooser to obscurity after a route is shown. The ayah reads as attachment-driven substitution.
2. **Acquired humiliation answers acquired blindness.** **ك س ب B001** gives seeking and obtaining gain; **ه و ن B003** gives abasement through contempt; **ء خ ذ B007** allows a condition taking hold. The end ties seizure to what they kept acquiring. I infer that repeated choices consolidate into a condition that can then take hold of its makers. Punishment is presented as the matured form of an earned orientation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:23 later states the same causal structure with greater precision: their own supposition brings them to ruin. 41:44 repeats guidance and blindness around the same discourse, showing that the preferred exchange remains available in the present audience.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Blindness as preferred attachment, not missing guidance.** Lexically, `ه د ي B001` is gentle guidance toward a way or truth, `ح ب ب B002` love as clinging attachment and preference, and `ع م ي B002` blindness of heart and insight. Structurally, guidance is first supplied, then blindness is selected “over” guidance, and 41:20–22 later turn hearing, sight, and skin into witnesses. I assign guidance the role of an available route, love the role of adhesive preference, and blindness the role of a chosen interpretive condition. The inferred arrow is that repeated preference stabilizes non-seeing into conduct. The ayah reads as an account of cultivated blindness rather than inability to find a path.

2. **Acquisition returns as seizure.** `ك س ب B001` is seeking and obtaining gain for oneself, while `ء خ ذ B001` is taking into possession. The final causal phrase places what they “earned” before the thunderbolt “took” them. I assign earning the role of cumulative self-acquisition and seizure the role of consequence taking possession of the acquirer. The mirrored taking relation is structural; the claim that accumulated choices make the seizure fitting is abductive. Consequence reads as a reversal of ownership.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:20–22 retrospectively made chosen blindness forensic. Sight, hearing, and skin are not absent; they remain capable witnesses, so the preferred blindness concerns interpretive allegiance rather than destroyed sensory equipment.

baseline.text: Semûd'a gelince, onlara doğru yolu gösterdik; ama onlar körlüğü doğru yola tercih ettiler. Kazandıkları yüzünden aşağılayıcı azabın yıldırımı onları yakaladı.

findings.text: Körlük, yol bulunamadığı için değil, gösterilen yola karşı yapışkan bir tercih geliştirildiği için kalıcı bir iç görüş hâline gelir.
Biriktirdikleri seçimler kendilerinin edindiği bir durumken, sonunda o durum tersine dönüp onları ele geçirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly warns of a thunderbolt like that of Thamud, framing the catastrophe named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes the messenger's limited agency from God's guidance, clarifying that the focus's guidance was granted rather than self-produced.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sworn concealment followed by blocking God's way and humiliating punishment supplies a related resistance-to-guidance pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A community is seized and left fallen, adding a concrete destruction scene but not the focus's choice of blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The reward for faith and righteous deeds is a same-surah positive counterpart to the focus's earned punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly joins guiding the blind with their error, closely illuminating the focus's blindness-versus-guidance language.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The preceding wind and humiliating punishment give the immediate surah setting for the focus's punishment of Thamud.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Secure guidance for uncorrupted faith provides a clear positive contrast to preferring blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud's defiance of the command and ensuing thunderbolt directly parallel the focus's people, choice, and punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Exact recompense for what people did supports the focus's closing account of what they earned.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the inability to guide the blind from error, though it adds little beyond 27:81.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Another cry seizes a destroyed people, now a redundant punishment-form parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The salvation of believing, God-conscious people immediately contrasts the fate of Thamud in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's knowledge of every self's earnings and their final outcome supports the focus's attribution of punishment to acquisition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Fire as the abode for what people earned reinforces the focus's consequence of accumulated acts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving what one loves is a remote constructive contrast to the focus's disastrous preference.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A self is held and punished for what it earned, extending the focus's earned-consequence logic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The declaration that their earnings did not avail them is a close Thamud-context parallel to the focus's final clause.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The smoke and compelled response share a channel context but do not clarify Thamud's chosen blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rebellion brings abiding fire and humiliating punishment, supporting the focus's punishment dimension.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: What people earned rusts over their hearts, directly developing the focus's reading of acquired choices becoming inner blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Each self is repaid for what it earned, supplying an explicit judgment-account counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's lack of love for the arrogant does not add a focused link to guidance, blindness, or earned punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Communal belief and God-consciousness contrast with denial, which brings seizure for what people earned, closely matching the focus's causal pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The claimed barriers to hearing in the same surah broadly echo refusal, but do not specify guidance or its consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Love of divine victory does not illuminate the focus's preference for blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Bodily testimony about what people earned develops personal accountability for the actions named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Humiliating punishment for injury is a broad consequence parallel, without the focus's guidance or Thamud setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Taking a town's people with hardship is a general warning pattern, but lacks the focus's decisive preference.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A meteorological strike crosses hearing, bodily sensation, and social standing to execute judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The punishment is not one image but a sensory sequence of cry, cold, haze, taste, and public abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Acoustic Cold Front
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A severe sound descends with a frigid wind, shocks its hearers, and drives a dust-darkened front.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: violent animal-like cry `quranic:root_000864:B001/m01`; upper-world thunderclap `quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`; stunned or dead victim `quranic:root_000864:B003/m01`; shrill rasping sound `quranic:root_000857:B002/m01`; frigid gale `quranic:root_000857:B004/m01`; cold ill-omened wind `quranic:root_001480:B002/m01`; drought-dust driven into the air `quranic:root_001480:B003/m01`; wind as overpowering force `quranic:root_000609:B011/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The thunderclap is at once sound, atmospheric blow, and cause of stunned collapse. Cold wind and driven dust extend the strike from an instant of noise into a sustained weather front.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A meteorological strike crosses hearing, bodily sensation, and social standing to execute judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The punishment is not one image but a sensory sequence of cry, cold, haze, taste, and public abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Smoke, Taste, and Shame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A darkened atmosphere enters the body as tasted experience and exits socially as exposed humiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rising smoke `quranic:root_000465:B001/m01`; smoke-darkened haze `quranic:root_000465:B003/m01`; smoke without flame `quranic:root_001480:B005/m01`; tasting food `quranic:root_000526:B001/m01`; experiential tasting and trial `quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`; sweet and potable substance `quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`; painful punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; public shame and expulsion `quranic:root_000407:B001/m01`; abasement by contempt `quranic:root_001608:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Taste ordinarily tests sweetness and suitability; here the same sensorium is made to register punishment. Smoke supplies the enveloping medium, while shame and abasement translate bodily affliction into a destroyed public position.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: From Trackless Ground to Protected Height
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Guidance establishes a traversable course, while protection completes that course in elevated safety.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The contrast between guidance and blindness becomes a topography of unmarked land, flood-safe high ground, and a barrier placed against harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Chosen Route and the Unmarked Waste
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A guide marks a direction, but the traveler prefers a landscape with no recognizable track.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gentle guidance to a path `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; direction and manner of travel `quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`; leader or foremost guide `quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`; blindness of judgment `quranic:root_001049:B002/m01`; unmarked land in which one cannot navigate `quranic:root_001049:B006/m01`; preference lodged in the heart `quranic:root_000286:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Guidance supplies both a leader and a marked direction. Preferred blindness removes the landmarks, turning the rejected guidance into the image of a traveler deliberately entering trackless terrain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intentional action produces a return that can appear as wage, acquired proceeds, or liability that takes hold of its earner.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral consequence is materialized through labor contracts and possession rather than through an abstract reward-punishment vocabulary alone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Acquisition Ends in Seizure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The agent gathers proceeds through action, but those proceeds become the ground on which accountability takes possession of the agent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earning and acquiring benefit `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; taking possession `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; holding a person to account for an offense `quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`; intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Earning first describes what the actor brings into possession. The reversal is that the consequence then takes possession of the actor, tightening acquisition and seizure into one causal loop.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir armağanı ya da yalnızca yolun kendisini değil, doğru yönü bildirme ve ona yönelme ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدى والهداية بمعنى الرشاد والدلالة والبيان وتعريف الطريق أو الحق والدين والاهتداء والتوفيق الإلهي وقبول الهدى

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدى نقيض الضلالة؛ هدي فاهتدى (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الهدى الرشاد والدلالة؛ هداه الله للدين هدى؛ أولم يبين لهم؛ هديته الطريق والبيت هداية أي عرفته (sihah)؛ الهدى البيان وإخراج شيء إلى شيء والطاعة والورع؛ دله على الطريق (tahdhib)؛ الهداية دلالة بلطف؛ تعريف الطرق؛ التوفيق (mufradat)؛ التقدم للإرشاد؛ هديته الطريق هداية؛ الهدى خلاف الضلالة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir işin yönünü ve amacını, kişinin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve yöntemini, ayrıca sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmamayı birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu çok parçalı fakat bağlantılı kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca genel bir yaşam tarzı değildir; yön ve amaç bildiren kullanımlarla belirli bir işte veya söylemde kalma kullanımını da içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yön, gidiş ve tutum bildiren biçimler ile kalıplaşmış benzerlik ve yineleme kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; özel kullanımlar çıplak kökün tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yönü, amacı ve izlenen doğrultusu ile bir kimsenin gidişi, görünür tutumu ve yöntemidir. Belirli anlatımlarda yürütülen söz ya da işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme, ona benzeme veya aynı karşılığı yineleme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
Bir kimsenin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve izlediği yöntemi anlatır.
Sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmama ve başkasının izlediği yolu izleme kullanımını içerir.
Özel bir söyleyişte benzerini verme veya aynı işi yeniden yapma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yön ve amaç ile kişinin izlediği yol ve görünür tutumu aynı kavramsal alanda toplar; sürmekte olan işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme ve özel bir söyleyişte benzerini ya da tekrarını yapma kullanımları buna bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin doğrultusunu ve bir kişinin davranış biçimini birlikte karşılayan genel kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön, amaç, yöntem, görünür tutum ve izlenen gidiş çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin hangi doğrultuya baktığı veya hangi amaçla yürütüldüğü sorulduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Kişinin tutumunu, yöntemini ve özel benzerlik ya da yineleme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin davranış biçiminin veya yönteminin örnek alınıp sürdürüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bir işin soyut yönünü ve benzerini verme ya da yineleme kullanımını belirtmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هدي الأمر أو هديته بمعنى جهته ووجهته وقصده وسيرته وطريقته وسمته وما يلازم ذلك من لزوم الحديث أو العمل والمماثلة في هدياها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدى بمعنى الإرشاد الديني وحده ولا الهدية العطية ولا مشي التمايل المعتمد على اثنين
branches.source_phrase_ar: خذ في هديتك أي فيما كنت فيه من الحديث أو العمل ولا تعدل عنه؛ هدية أمره وسيرته؛ هدى هدي فلان أي سار سيرته (sihah)؛ هدية أمره أي جهة أمره؛ هديت به أي قصدت به؛ هديه أي سمته؛ ليس لهذا الأمر هدية ولا قبلة ولا دبرة ولا وجهة؛ هدياها أي مثلها أو أعاودك (tahdhib)؛ هدية فلان وهديه أي طريقته (mufradat)؛ نظر فلان هدي أمره أي جهته؛ ما أحسن هديته أي هديه؛ رميت بآخر هدياه أي قصده (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü temel olarak bir şeyin ilk veya önde bulunan bölümünü bildirir; yol gösterme, bazı öndekilerin başkalarına öncülük etmesinden doğan bağlı bir açıklamadır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak her öndeki parçanın yol gösterdiği düşünülmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek öncülük etmek değil, önde veya ilk sırada bulunmaktır; yol gösterme yalnızca uygun örneklerde buna bağlanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak ilk veya öndeki şey anlamı ile atların, yaban hayvanlarının, okun ve koyunun belirli ön parçalarını adlandıran kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilk, önde bulunan veya öne çıkan bölümü ya da üyesidir. Atların boyunları veya ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, okun ucu, koyunun boynu ve sahibinin önünde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
Atların boyunlarını veya ilk sırasını ve yaban hayvanlarının önde gidenlerini adlandırır.
Okun ucunu ve koyunun boynunu, öndeki parçalar olmaları bakımından adlandırır.
Önden ilerleyen değnek veya kılavuz, önde bulunma yoluyla başkasına yön gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin ilk ve öndeki bölümünde birleşir; atların boynu ya da ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, koyun boynu, ok ucu ve önde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeği farklı nesnelerde gerçekleştirir. Önden giden kılavuz da aynı konumsal ilişkiyle adlandırılır.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel konumsal çekirdeği ve hayvan, araç ya da nesnelerdeki özel ön bölüm adlarını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İlk olma, önde bulunma ve buna bağlı ön bölüm örneklerini korur.

error_profile.loses: Tek bir nesnenin ön parçasını ve ok ucu ya da boyun gibi özel adları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne veya hayvan gövdesindeki önde bulunan parçanın adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir bütünün önde bulunan parçası olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Öncü grup ve önden giderek yol gösterme kullanımını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün başlangıçta veya ön tarafta bulunan bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal önde giden üyeleri ve kaynakta sayılan özel ön parçaları toplar; komşu dal ise ön, üst ve başlangıç konumunu daha genel biçimde kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün öncülük, ilk sıra ve ön bölüm adayları değerlendirildi; genel ön bölüm komşusu sınırı en doğrudan açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهادي أو الهادية بمعنى أول الشيء وما تقدم منه كأعناق الخيل وأول رعيلها وأوائل الوحش ورقبة الشاة ونصل السهم والعصا أو الدليل حين يتقدمان
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدى المجرد عن معنى التقدم ولا الهدية العطية ولا الهادي الراكس في البيدر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهادي من كل شيء أوله؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ العصا هاديا لأنها تتقدمه؛ الدليل يسمى هاديا لتقدمه (ayn)؛ هادي السهم نصله؛ الهادي العنق؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ الهاديات أوائل الوحش (sihah)؛ الهادية من كل شيء أوله وما تقدم منه؛ هادية الشاة الرقبة؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ هاديات الوحش أوائلها (tahdhib)؛ هوادي الوحش متقدماتها الهادية لغيرها (mufradat)؛ كل متقدم لذلك هاد؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها؛ هاديها أول رعيل؛ الهادية العصا لأنها تتقدم ممسكها (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sevgi bağı bulunan birine incelik ve iyilik amacıyla gönderilen armağanı, karşılıklı armağan vermeyi, armağanın sunulduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi açıkça kapsar. Dal çerçevesi bütün bu türevleri doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sıradan mal aktarımı değil, incelik ve yakınlık işareti olan armağan esastır; kutsal yere adanan sunu ayrı daldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak armağan ve armağan verme alanı tanımlanır; kutsal amaçlı sunu, gelini eşine götürme ve şiirsel atışma anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik ve iyilik göstergesi olarak bir şey gönderme ya da verme ve verilen şeydir. Karşılıklı armağanlaşma, sunma tabağı ve bunu sık yapan kişi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.
Böyle bir armağanı birine göndermek veya vermek eylemidir.
İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı armağan vermesini kapsar.
Armağanın üzerine konduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar armağanı yakınlık duyulan kişiye incelik ve iyilik amacıyla verilen şey olarak tanımlar; verme eylemi, karşılıklı verme, sunma tabağı ve sık veren kişi bu ortak çekirdeğin bağlı türevleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Armağanın kendisini, verilmesini ve yakınlık kuran karşılıklı değişimi birlikte temsil eden genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Armağanı, incelik amacını, verme eylemini ve karşılıklılığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakınlık ve incelik göstergesi olarak verilen nesnenin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İncelik amacıyla verilen şey olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Verme eylemini, karşılıklılığı, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı olarak armağan verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Tek armağanın adını, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Seçkin veya ender bulunan bir nesne ve birine iyilikte bulunma vurgusu komşu dalda öne çıkar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlaşma amacıyla gönderilen hayvanı, malı ya da eşyayı bildirir; bazı anlatımlar alanı özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlar, bazıları daha geniş tutar. Dal çerçevesi bu kapsam değişkenliğini ve deveye uzanan kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal insanlar arasındaki sıradan armağanı değil, kutsal bir hedefe yaklaşma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunuyu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak adanmış sunu anlamı tanımlanır; sıradan armağan, ibadete giriş ve kutsal yolculuğun kendisi bu dala katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlık kazanma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen hayvan, mal ya da eşyadır. Kimi anlatımlar bunu özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlara bağlar; develerin genel olarak aynı adla anılması ise bu kullanımdan genişlemedir.

facets.statement: Kutsal bir hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunudur.
Sununun kapsamı kimi anlatımlarda büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlı, kimilerinde mal ve eşyayı da içerecek kadar geniştir.
Develerin genel olarak bu adla anılması, kutsal yere gönderilen deve sunusundan gelişen bir genişlemedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla gönderilen sunuda birleşir; kapsamın yalnızca büyükbaş hayvanlar mı yoksa mal ve eşya da mı olduğu değişir, develerin genel adı olarak kullanım da bu çekirdekten genişler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kutsal bölgeye gönderilen sununun özellikle büyükbaş bir hayvan olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.
